trial_court: Court of the District Judge, Tehri Garhwal
case_name: Smt. Aina Devi vs Bachan Singh And Anr.
facts_of_case: Petitioner's marriage with respondent was alleged to be void as respondent already had a wife living. Petitioner claimed she needed a Ghar Jawai and took respondent as her husband who lived at her place for about 10 months.

legal_principles.principle: Either party to a marriage can have it declared null and void by a decree of nullity if it contravenes any condition specified in Section 5 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Section 11 specifically enables either party to the marriage to have it declared null and void by a decree of nullity, against the other party.

legal_principles.principle: A party to a marriage cannot be denied relief if they are victims of societal customs and practices.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner would, if her allegations are true, appear to be more sinned against than a sinner, a victim of the customs of the society in which she lived.

outcome.final_order: Trial court's judgment dismissing petition for declaring marriage nullity was upheld.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for nullity of marriage
